selection_rule: Minimum feasible selection J across all completed registered trials; tie by earlier epoch, smaller LR, stable ID

selection_rule.fallback: Original if no feasible epoch endpoint

configuration.selection: preregistered selection-only objective; best.pt plus last.pt retained
configuration.energy_interpretation: Unsquared Euclidean distances; both self terms are off-diagonal U-statistics. Finite-sample estimates can be negative. Iid unbiasedness does not imply exact full finite-dataset energy under without-replacement minibatches or random singleton-class omission. No Wasserstein or deletion guarantee.

metadata.energy_interpretation: Unsquared Euclidean distances; both self terms are off-diagonal U-statistics. Finite-sample estimates can be negative. Iid unbiasedness does not imply exact full finite-dataset energy under without-replacement minibatches or random singleton-class omission. No Wasserstein or deletion guarantee.

energy_statistics.singleton_rule: skip current class with n<2; macro-average remaining classes

deployment.checkpoint_rule: fixed final epoch last.pt on all new seeds, not their selected best.pt

policy: No changes to algorithm/hyperparameters/stopping epoch from confirmation calibration, audit or test; report failures and all registered outcomes. This is calibration-guided development after the separately frozen first-round test results.
